POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.

2. When learning Careers in Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers in Power Mechanics.

3. When learning Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

4. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

6. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.

7. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.

8. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to computer aided drawing.

9. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Management of Road Transport.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Management of Road Transport.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

11. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

12. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Power Mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle batteries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Road Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
